title: Changing a work order's customer never changes its representatives
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use customer A, whose one Sales Representative is sales rep A, so the work order starts with sales rep A.
  • Use customer B, whose one Sales Representative is sales rep B.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for customer A, with one approved labor line and one part, so that its one "Sales Representative" field reads sales rep A (copied from customer A when it was created).
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps: 1. Change the work order's customer to customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order's customer is customer B.
  • Its Sales Representative still reads sales rep A.
  • It does not take customer B's sales rep B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R28: “The customer's representatives are copied only when the work order or part sale is created. Changing the customer on an existing work order or part sale never changes its representatives.”
